blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) on Thursday said that small-scale Philippine offshore gaming operators (Pogos) continue to exist despite the ban on such hubs. Justice Undersecretary Nicholas Felix Ty cited the possible resurgence of such illegal operations as Chinese nationals were reportedly being apprehended for overstaying their visa-free privilege.
